# Question banks

A menu of TOPICS for choice questions. Pick only what changes decisions for this task; write the options yourself,
specific to the case (real numbers, channels, dates, names). Example options are illustrations, not a script.

---

## General (every task)

**Goal**
- Primary outcome (pick ONE): sales/revenue · leads/sign-ups · awareness/reach · retention/repeat · internal/efficiency
- Why now — trigger: seasonal event · launch · drop in results · competitor move · new budget · request from a client
- Who decides it is done / approves: you · client · manager · team

**Audience / stakeholders**
- Who it is for: existing customers · new customers · a specific segment · partners · internal team
- Market & language: BG · RO · EU · global; language(s) of the output

**Deliverable & scope**
- Type of output: document/plan · creative assets · copy · setup in a tool · analysis/report · a mix
- Size: how many pieces / pages / variants
- Out of scope (pick what to exclude explicitly)

**Constraints**
- Deadline: this week · ≤ 2 weeks · this month · flexible — plus the hard date if any
- Budget band (always banded options, never "how much?")
- Brand/tone: existing guideline · follow past materials · new direction · no constraints
- Approvals/legal: none · client approval · legal/compliance check · regulated category (alcohol, tobacco, pharma, finance, kids)

**Success**
- KPI (pick ONE primary) + target band
- Measurement source: GA4 · Meta Ads Manager · Google Ads · CRM · sales system · none yet

**Context**
- What was tried before: nothing · tried and worked · tried and failed · not sure
- Assets available: brand kit · photos/video · copy · product feed · audiences/lists · none
- Reference/competitor examples: have some · want suggestions · not needed

---

## Marketing campaigns & ads

- Campaign objective in platform terms: sales/conversions · leads · traffic · engagement · reach/awareness · app installs
- Channels (single-choice combos when multi-select is unavailable): Meta only · Google only · Meta + Google · + TikTok · + e-mail/SMS
- Funnel stage: cold prospecting · retargeting · existing customers · full funnel
- Offer: discount % · free shipping · gift/bundle · no offer (brand) · limited drop
- Budget split & pacing: daily vs lifetime · front-loaded around a date · even
- Duration / flight dates
- Geo & language targeting
- Audiences: broad · interests · lookalikes · custom lists · retargeting windows (7/14/30 d)
- Creative format: static · carousel · video/reels · UGC · catalog/DPA
- Number of creative variants & A/B test needed? (what to test: creative · audience · offer · none)
- Landing: product page · category · dedicated landing page · lead form · needs to be built
- Tracking readiness: pixel/CAPI OK · GA4 events OK · unsure → check first · missing
- Attribution window & what counts as a conversion
- Reporting: cadence (daily/weekly/end) and format (dashboard/sheet/summary)
- Risks: ad policy (restricted category) · stock/inventory limits · seasonality overlap

## Content & SEO

- Content type: article/blog · product/category descriptions · social posts · e-mail/newsletter · landing copy · video script
- Volume & cadence: one piece · series of N · ongoing calendar (per week)
- Search intent / funnel stage: informational · commercial · transactional · navigational
- Keywords: have a list · need research · target one main keyword · no SEO goal
- Length band: short (< 300 words) · medium (600–1 200) · long (1 500+)
- Tone of voice: expert · friendly/casual · premium/luxury · playful · follow existing examples
- Structure needs: FAQ · tables/comparisons · CTA · internal links · schema markup
- Sources & claims: own expertise · cite sources · product data only · no claims allowed (regulated)
- Images/media: provided · generate · stock · none
- Publishing: who publishes, which CMS, draft vs publish directly
- Localisation: one language · translate · adapt per market
- Success: rankings · organic traffic · CTR · engagement · conversions from content

## Product / e-commerce / strategy

- Decision type: promo/sale · pricing change · new product/category launch · assortment · UX/checkout change · market entry · strategy doc
- Scope of products: whole store · category · brand · selected SKUs · new SKUs
- Mechanics (promos): % off · fixed amount · bundle · gift with purchase · free shipping threshold · code vs automatic
- Margin floor / max discount allowed
- Stock & supply: enough stock · limited · pre-order · dropship constraints
- Channels affected: web · marketplaces · physical store · B2B
- Markets/stores affected: one store · several (which)
- Dependencies: dev work · supplier · payment/courier · legal (T&C, price indication rules)
- Competitor benchmark needed? yes · no · already known
- Analysis depth (strategy): quick recommendation · options with pros/cons · full plan with numbers
- Time horizon: one-off · quarter · year
- Success: revenue · margin · AOV · conversion rate · units · new customers
- Rollback / what if it underperforms: stop · adjust · run to end

## Edge cases (ask near the end, only if relevant)

- What happens if the deadline slips / budget is cut by half — which part is dropped first?
- What must NOT happen (brand, legal, customer experience red lines)?
- Who needs to be informed before launch?
- Dependencies on other people/teams that could block it
